title: Taigrys Utils
description: A simple utilities mod with various tweaks.
body:
# ❓ About

**Taigrys Utils** adds many different client-side tweaks.
Ranging from some basic ones like FPS displays, to advanced built-in autoclickers! _(But remember, you may even get banned if an AntiCheat detects something weird!)_

# 🗒️ Features:
Currently, the mod does not have that much tweaks, of course many more will come in the future.

📋Open the Taigrys Utils Menu by pressing **H**📋

## HUD
- Coordinates - Displays your current coordinates.
- FPS Display - Displays your current FPS.
- Facing Direction - Displays your current facing direction.
- TPS Display - Displays the server's current TPS.
- Fall Distance - When you are falling, displays the amount of blocks that you fell.

## World Info
- Time Display - Cool clock.
- Biome Display - Displays the biome you are currently on.

## Visuals
- Fullbright - fullbright.
- Glow Alert - Alerts you when you have the **Glowing** effect. I needed it, you may not.

## Combat
- Enemy Research - Displays the armor, its durability and **Protection Enchantment** level, and main hand weapon and its **Sharpness Enchantment** level, and health of the player you are looking at.
When looking at a mob, just displays its health.

## Auto Clicker
- Configure Left/Right Click.
- Randomize CPS - Makes the CPS vary a little, giving 2.67% less chance of getting detected.
- Only Holding - Makes the clicker spam only when you are holding a specific mouse button.
- Set CPS - 1-20.
- You can also toggle the left/right click with a keybind.
